about.description: CASH is Dreamcash's third-party perpetual venue on Hyperliquid, operated by Supreme Liquid Labs and strategically backed by Tether and Selini Capital. The platform offers AI-enhanced trading on equity, ETF, equity-index, and commodity perpetual markets, all margined and cash-settled in USDT0 with up to 40x leverage. Markets appear under the cash namespace on Hyperliquid via HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetuals; the front-end is a self-custodial mobile/web app that abstracts the on-chain experience while keeping settlement transparent.
about.registryInfo: Dreamcash is operated by Supreme Liquid Labs. Tether (USDT0 issuer) holds a strategic investment alongside Selini Capital, with both backing the rollout of USDT0-collateralized RWA perpetual markets on Hyperliquid. Markets are deployed under the cash namespace via Hyperliquid HIP-3.

fees.revenueNotes: CASH (issued by Bridge Building Inc., a Bridge.xyz subsidiary) is a USD-backed stablecoin maintained 1:1 with USD reserves. Revenue from float income on USD reserves invested in short-duration treasuries and bank deposits (similar to USDC model). Used as the stablecoin rail for Dreamcash equity-perp deployer markets.
